answers.answer: Twitch is already connected because I signed in with it. To add YouTube or Kick: on Home, find the platform's row in the Connections panel (it reads Not connected) and press its Connect button. The row asks a question; press the second Connect button beside it. A new window opens; sign in there and approve. The window says Connected and closes by itself, and the row then shows my account name. The Connect button does the same thing from the Where it goes panel on the Overview tab of Stream.
answers.quote: Choose the row’s Connect button. The row now asks “Connect YouTube to this channel?”, or the same for Kick.

answers.answer: I need the role that may connect and disconnect integrations, which by default is Editor or Broadcaster. I also need my own account on the platform I connect. Both are stated in the second paragraph, before the steps. A moderator does not see the button, and the Troubleshooting box says to ask the broadcaster or an editor.
answers.quote: By default that is an Editor or the Broadcaster.

answers.answer: It worked when the window says Connected and closes itself, the Done button goes away, and the row shows my account name on that platform. On Home, a green dot with Live means I am live there; a gray dot with Offline means connected but not broadcasting; Not connected with a gray dot means no connection.
answers.quote: The window says “Connected” and closes by itself. On Home, the Done button goes away, and the row shows your account name on that platform.

answers.answer: The YouTube-only streamer opens Home, sees YouTube as Not connected, and uses the row's Connect, then the confirm Connect, then signs in; the YouTube row then shows the account name. The Kick row stays Not connected, which is fine. Later Spotify reads Not connected because a broken saved sign-in also shows as Not connected; Home never says Sign in again. As broadcaster, they renew it through Settings, then Integrations under the Connections heading, then Reconnect on the Spotify row, then sign in again, then Back to dashboard; the badge reads Connected. An Editor could use the Open connected services link only while YouTube is not connected or the bot may not read analytics or members; since YouTube is now connected, that would usually fall to the broadcaster.
answers.quote: A service whose saved sign-in no longer works also reads “Not connected”, so Home never says “Sign in again”.

answers.answer: I learned what happens with a blocked pop-up only after the steps, where step 3 had told me a new window opens. It costs a moment of doubt if the tab moves away instead, but the page covers it right after the list. I also reread the Editor renew route to work out when the Open connected services link shows; the conditions come before the steps, so I did not need to guess.
answers.quote: If the browser blocks the new window, the dashboard tab itself goes to the platform.

answers.answer: Connections names both the panel on Home and a heading in the Settings list. Read aloud, the renew steps could sound like the Home panel, which costs a short pause. Nothing explains what a stream bot is for.
answers.quote: Under the Connections heading of that list, choose Integrations.
